title: PIL and EDNA Reciprocal Share-Award Buyback Agreement
content:
RECIPROCAL SHARE-AWARD BUYBACK AGREEMENT

Document date: September 23, 2026

Pulse Intelligence Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("PIL"), and EDNA, Inc. ("EDNA"), together the "Parties," agree to the following contractual repurchase price for their reciprocal Strategic Share Awards. This Agreement is part of the coordinated strategic equity signing package comprising the PIL Strategic Vesting Share Agreement (the "PIL Share Agreement"), the Revised Reciprocal Strategic Equity Side Letter (the "Side Letter"), and the matching reciprocal Share Award instruments. Capitalized terms not defined here retain their meanings in those instruments.

1. RECIPROCAL CONTRACTUAL PRICE

PIL shall pay EDNA $0.10 for each original PIL Share Award share lawfully repurchased by PIL under Section 3.5 of the PIL Share Agreement, or $20,000 if PIL repurchases all 200,000 original award shares. EDNA shall pay PIL the same contractual price of $0.10 for each original EDNA Share Award share lawfully repurchased by EDNA under the matching reciprocal definitive instrument, or $20,000 if EDNA repurchases all 200,000 original award shares. Each issuing company pays the holder when exercising its own permitted repurchase option.

The $20,000 amount applies separately to the full award issued by each company. It is payable only to the extent that an eligible repurchase is elected and lawfully completed. This Agreement does not require either company to repurchase shares merely because this Agreement has been signed.

2. PROPORTIONATE APPLICATION AND CORPORATE ADJUSTMENTS

For each award, the payment equals $0.10 multiplied by the number of original award shares actually repurchased: 50,000 shares cost $5,000 and 100,000 shares cost $10,000. A partial repurchase does not require payment of the full $20,000. No subsequent appreciation is included.

The per-share price and share count shall be equitably and inversely adjusted for stock splits, combinations and similar recapitalizations so that the aggregate price for the full adjusted award remains $20,000. If the Parties confirm a different reciprocal award count to satisfy the initial closing requirements, they must approve the corresponding per-share price in writing, with all required approvals, before closing; the agreed full-award amount remains $20,000. This provision does not itself change any share count or create a continuing percentage or anti-dilution right.

3. EXISTING REPURCHASE PROTECTIONS

This price applies only to issued Strategic Share Award shares eligible for repurchase under the applicable definitive Share Award instrument, including vested shares when that instrument permits. The specified fraud, intellectual-property theft, misconduct, uncured material breach and other Repurchase Events remain governed by those instruments.

All existing notice and cure rights, required admissions or final binding determinations, exercise deadlines, closing procedures, representative-attribution and Shared Account protections, dispute procedures, corporate approvals, binding investor rights and applicable-law limitations remain in force. An allegation alone does not establish a Repurchase Event or transfer ownership. This Agreement adds no Repurchase Event, creates no automatic forfeiture and creates no repurchase right solely upon ordinary expiration, nonrenewal or termination. Payment and transfer remain subject to a lawful closing under the applicable definitive instrument.

4. SEPARATE FINANCIAL TERMS AND WARRANTS

The price in Sections 1 and 2 is a negotiated contractual repurchase price. PIL's Consideration and Buyback-Cost Schedule separately states a fair market value of $0.01 per PIL common share and an aggregate noncash award consideration value of $2,000, subject to the required board determination. Those stated amounts are unchanged by this Agreement. They do not establish EDNA's fair market value, either Party's adjusted tax basis, or the tax treatment of any later repurchase.

The contractual price is independent of fair market value, tax or accounting value, legally sufficient noncash consideration and par value. Each company remains responsible for its separate determinations and approvals. Warrant shares are excluded. This Agreement does not change either separate Warrant's exercise price, vesting, term, exercise mechanics or other purchase rights.

5. ADOPTION AND RELATIONSHIP TO THE SIGNING PACKAGE

Upon authorized execution by both Parties, all required corporate approvals, execution of the conforming definitive instruments, and satisfaction of the coordinated closing conditions, Sections 1 and 2 constitute the Parties' written adoption of the reciprocal contractual repurchase price. They replace any inconsistent original-acquisition-cost pricing for these Share Awards in Section 3.5(c) of the PIL Share Agreement, the Side Letter and the corresponding reciprocal EDNA Share Award instrument. The revised PIL Consideration and Buyback-Cost Schedule shall accompany the same signing package as the supporting consideration record. All other terms, protections and conditions of those instruments remain in effect.

This Agreement shall be read together with the matching Section 3.5(c), Side Letter and reciprocal instrument provisions in the signing package. Its pricing does not waive the requirement for effective reciprocal Share Award delivery, required capitalization and consideration records, sufficient share reservations, required consents, or any other coordinated closing condition. It does not itself issue shares, complete an equity closing, establish a fair market value determination, or evidence a prior signature. PIL's approval or signature alone does not bind EDNA.

The governing law, notices and dispute procedures applicable to the PIL Share Agreement under Section 7.2 govern this Agreement, subject to mandatory law applicable to either issuer and its shares.

6. EXECUTION

The document date identifies this signing copy. Each signatory's actual execution date shall be recorded with that signatory's electronic signature. Effectiveness remains subject to Section 5. The Parties may execute this Agreement in counterparts and by electronic signature on the same basis provided in their definitive equity instruments.
